subject: Consolidated Offer Bundle: usage examples, CTA placement & SKU mapping
messages:
From: Alex Nguyen <alex@datasense.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft: Consolidated offer bundle + suggested usage examples

Hi Marissa / Vanessa / Ben,

Thanks again for the call earlier — excited about combining Redwood Hosted + Dedicated + Optimize as a single 'Offer Bundle' on AWS Marketplace. I attached a rough pricing table and a one-page landing draft (bundle_pricing_table.xlsx, landing_draft_v3.md) to make the discussion concrete.

Main asks from our side:
- Can you confirm whether we should present this as a single public listing with discrete SKUs (hosted/dedicated/optimize) or as a Private Offer + public AMI?
- We included three short usage examples (SaaS scale-up, enterprise POC, regulated telemetry). Please flag which are accurate and which need rewording.
- CTA flow: we recommend CTA 1 = "Start Free Trial" (hosted), CTA 2 = "Contact Sales for Dedicated" (private offer). Thoughts?

We're targeting an initial go-live in early December to align with Q4 channel campaigns, so quick feedback would be much appreciated.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 30-min sync if that's easier.

— Alex Nguyen
Head of Partnerships, DataSense Inc.
Attachments: bundle_pricing_table.xlsx (spreadsheet), landing_draft_v3.md (markdown), usage_examples_sketch.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@datasense.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Consolidated offer bundle + suggested usage examples

Alex — thanks for putting this together, really helpful. Quick notes after a run-through:

1) Public listing vs Private Offer
- Recommend public listing for the Hosted & Optimize SKUs (easier discovery and PLG funnel).
- Recommend Private Offer for Dedicated capacity (reservation/commit terms) — we can link to the public listing for Hosted so the marketing/SEO benefits remain.

2) SKU and pricing presentation
- The attached pricing table looks close; we need a short footnote clarifying burst/baseline behavior for Dedicated (examples: 2.0x baseline commit, 5.0x short-term burst cap). Add a one-line billing footnote "Dedicated burst billed as overage if sustained beyond 5 minutes".

3) Usage examples (please revise text in attachment)
- SaaS scale-up example: trim to two bullets focused on latency and cost-per-token improvement with Optimize.
- Enterprise POC: include an explicit sentence about "data isolation via Private deployment".
- Regulated telemetry: please add "SOC 2 evidence available on request" (this prevents claims we can't assert publicly).

4) CTA alignment
- I prefer: CTA A = "Try Hosted (Free Credits)" — primary button on hero; CTA B (smaller secondary) = "Request Dedicated Pricing" (this should open a Private Offer request form).

5) Next steps
- Ben / Karthik: can you validate the billing footnote wording and the SKU mapping to our AMI/offer taxonomy?
- Alex: please return a revised landing_draft_v3.md with the three usage blips shortened; I'll iterate on headline copy once we have the SKU decision.

If it's helpful I can schedule a 30-min alignment call Mon or Tue morning PT.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0188

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Draft: Consolidated offer bundle + suggested usage examples

Marissa — quick confirmation on the two technical/billing asks:

- Billing footnote: agree with your proposed sentence but suggest: 'Dedicated burst is billed as overage after a 5-minute sustained burst window; short bursts under 5 minutes are absorbed by buffer credits.' This language matches our metering rules.
- SKU mapping: we should map SKUs like this: RBW-Hosted, RBW-Optimize, RBW-Dedicated-<region>-COMMIT. For the private offer we'll append a PO-ID to the SKU for reconciliation.

Also linking to the Marketplace pre-checklist: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-bundle-landing-v3 (see the 'billing footnotes' tab).

— Ben
Senior Product Manager, GTM | Redwood Inference

From: AWS Marketplace PM <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@partnerops.io>, Alex Nguyen <alex@datasense.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Draft: Consolidated offer bundle + suggested usage examples

Hi Marissa / team,

Thanks for sharing the draft. A couple of compliance/ops items before we can progress to listing approval:

1) Public vs Private Offer optics: AWS favors a public listing for discoverability. Private Offers are fine for committed-reservation products, but please ensure the public listing has a clear 'Contact for Dedicated' CTA and a Private Offer workflow link.

2) Required artifacts:
- Finalized product one-liner and three usage scenarios (one paragraph each).
- A single-sheet billing footnotes document (PDF or spreadsheet) with exact meter names and rounding rules.
- Marketplace AMI/AMI tag mapping or ECR image reference if using images.

3) Timeline & next step: we can review the updated artifacts and perform an automated validation on Mon 24 Nov. If possible, upload the revised landing_draft and billing footnotes to the shared drive and post the HubSpot record (HS-984321) so our onboarding team can pick it up.

4) DocuSign for Private Offer flow: I'll send a DocuSign link for the PO template once you confirm SKU mappings.

Happy to join a short call Mon 24 Nov 10:00 PT if you want synchronous sign-off.

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Team
aws-marketplace@amazon.com
